summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K reporting routine daily ASX disclosures tied to its previously authorized $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce information furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on the stated dates; no new authorization, price, premium or closing terms were announced. The filing notes forward-looking statements regarding intent to repurchase from time to time, subject to market conditions, securities laws and available alternatives. Watch for the pace of buybacks, dual-class share usage and any acceleration or suspension that could signal shifting capital-allocation priorities.
